GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 312.4 (19 Feb 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 755)
APO 500
19 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Delivery of documents relative to the so-called March, October and November Incidents.
1. Imperial Japanese Government will deliver on or about 20 February 1946, official documents of the trials, and other documents relative to:
a. The March Incident of 1931.
b. The October Incident of 1931.
c. The November (or Kinki Kakumei) Incident of 1934.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
